description: This file implements the container object functions for a Network Service Lookup TDO (Timeout Duration Object) in a diagnostic module, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization functions. It is part of a larger system related to network diagnostics within a broader framework.

classes.name: BBHM_NS_LOOKUP_TDO_OBJECT
classes.description: Structure representing the Network Service Lookup Timeout Duration Object, including configuration parameters like timer type, interval, counter, and function pointers for operations.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE BbhmDiagnsTdoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new instance of the TDO object, assigning core properties and linking functions.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagnsTdoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the TDO object and performs cleanup.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagnsTdoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls or registers necessary subordinate objects or resources for the TDO.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagnsTdoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the TDO object, sets default values for specific properties, and calls base class initialization.
